criteria.name: Product specificity
criteria.notes: Official workflow accepts a real software screen recording and brand kit, but AIVP has not verified pixel-accurate identity or first-10-second visibility.

criteria.name: Output quality
criteria.notes: 1080p, watermark-free and post-ready are vendor claims; no saved AIVP output.

criteria.name: Control and consistency
criteria.notes: Four takes and plain-language revisions are documented but untested.

criteria.name: Workflow strength
criteria.notes: Official pages document prompt/screen-recording input, beat planning, four cuts, revisions and export.

criteria.name: Speed and reliability
criteria.notes: About twenty minutes is an unverified vendor estimate; no failure-rate evidence.

criteria.name: Cost efficiency
criteria.notes: Free-to-start is stated, but limits and cost per accepted export are unknown.

criteria.name: Commercial rights
criteria.notes: Terms grant ownership of generated videos; explicit monetized-publication and vendor-media permission still requested.

criteria.name: Automation and integration
criteria.notes: Published MCP package supports four coding agents; security and operational behavior remain unaudited.

criteria.name: AU creator/SMB fit
criteria.notes: Strong software-launch use case and web access; Australia-specific availability/billing not documented.

criteria.name: Monetization fit
criteria.notes: High-intent launch-video/editorial topic; no affiliate program found, so points reflect AdSense/editorial relevance only.

analysis: Differentiated agent-to-motion-canvas workflow with real screen-recording inputs and documented output ownership, but all performance-critical criteria remain untested.
confidence_notes: Primary vendor pages, terms, Product Hunt listing and npm documentation only; no hands-on AIVP run.
